record.summary: No qualifying institute identified. The National Assembly archived a comprehensive AI bill on 15 September 2026 and admitted a separate AI-governance bill on 28 September; El Diario counted 12 AI-related initiatives on 27 October.

check.language_note: The recorded es query uses a national or official language selected for this country-specific check. Other national or official languages were not exhaustively searched. Search source_ids identify registered source URLs matched in the retrieved result set, which may include irrelevant hits. An empty list means no registered source URL was matched, not that the web response was empty. The earlier audit used independent_source_ids for substantive corroboration; governance_source_ids, where present, identifies the selected primary governance evidence. Preserved result batches, using 1-based positions in check.searches: EC-search = searches 1, 2 (en, es). Each multi-query batch has only a combined returned result set; its source_ids cannot be attributed to individual queries. Historical query dates are recorded as 17 October 2026 in the phase6 search-boundary ledger.
check.independence_note: Historical audit under the superseded two-independent-sources rule: Two substantively independent evidence origins were not established. Multiple pages from one owner, mirrors, reports of the same underlying announcement and general regional coverage are not counted as independent corroboration.
check.governance_note: The National Assembly reports archiving the AI-regulation bill. This is primary evidence about the legislative governance process, not a denial of an institute.

record.notes:
Ecuador adopted a national AI strategy in December 2025 and launched it in March 2026. The archived bill would have created a national AI control authority with algorithm-audit access; the bill text was not read directly.

The National Assembly confirms that the comprehensive AI bill was archived on 15 September 2026. Searches covered indexed public English and Spanish sources for a government-designated AI safety institute with a remit to evaluate advanced models. The Assembly's 30 September report says a resolution directed the Education Committee to begin considering the bill admitted on 28 September and allowed it to combine related proposals.
